unitReview: SpecialEnergy1 is original-client Frost, in native client units, not a player-facing numeric Frost label. SpecialEnergy2 is the four-Auspice capacity. Existing canonical full-Frost semantics are retained; no guessed displayed maximum is introduced.

restorationReview.actionClockSource: Maygi Youhu row99: Fortune Rolling1s/fullFrost. The full hold exceeds the original ten restoration ticks, then releases Frostfall; no partial-Frost hit cadence is inferred.

conditionalScope: Lucky Draw outcomes must be explicitly conditioned. A fixed artifact sequence is not an RNG average and does not assert equal probabilities. Generic community Appraisal clocks are not individual antique gameplay measurements.
